payload.summary: Final configured implementation-review round reached max iteration with two confirmed deterministic blockers. Codex, Antigravity, and Grok supplied schema-valid reviews (20 raw findings, 13 unique, 6 confirmed, 7 unconfirmed, 0 disagreements); consensus records 2 blocking fixes. Claude timed out and Pi authentication was expired, both preserved in the dispatch manifest.
completed_work: Dispatched read-only integrated implementation reviews to Antigravity, Claude Code, Grok, and Pi; Antigravity and Grok returned schema-valid findings, Claude timed out at 720 seconds, and Pi reported auth_required.
Combined the primary Codex review with two valid external reviews and met quorum 3/3: 20 raw findings, 13 unique findings, 6 confirmed, 7 unconfirmed, 0 disagreements, and 2 blockers.
Independently reproduced malformed refine-roadmap approval loss: decide exited successfully while durable sanitization removed the selected stub.

Independently reproduced the unscored-survivor interruption defect: terminal pruning published an empty digest, then the next unchanged preflight returned lifecycle_changed false while the survivor remained stored and requestable.
Ran the complete supervise suite (349 passed), ruff, strict OpenSpec validation, canonical skill install synchronization, and schema validation for all admitted review documents and consensus.
Preserved the final-round prompt, primary findings, successful external findings, dispatch manifest, and consensus under reviews/implementation/round-3/.

decisions.title: Escalate final implementation-review non-convergence
decisions.rationale: This is round 3 of 3 and consensus contains two confirmed deterministic critical findings, so the phase outcome is max_iter rather than another automatic IMPL_FIX loop.

decisions.title: Preserve bounded vendor failures as review evidence
decisions.rationale: Claude exhausted the configured timeout and Pi required renewed authentication; the primary plus two successful external vendors still met the required three-reviewer quorum.

next_steps: At the implementation-review convergence gate, present the two confirmed blockers and request operator direction for a targeted post-cap fix.
Validate refine-roadmap references inside decide before any mirror write and add a no-write malformed-reference regression.
Treat remaining store keys absent from prior digest ranking as composition drift so an interruption cannot hide an unscored survivor behind the unchanged early exit.
After authorized fixes, rerun scoped verification and an independent implementation review before validation.
